title: fbq('track','Lead') sends nothing while custom events go through
symptoms: Events Manager shows only PageView and ViewContent
cause: Pixels for some business categories carry a restriction on certain standard events. Lead, Purchase, Schedule, CompleteRegistration and other mid and lower funnel events are dropped in the browser. Custom events are also blocked until they are reviewed and confirmed in Events Manager. Campaigns can then optimize for an unrelated page view without anyone noticing.
fix: Inspect the pixel's config for the restricted list. Send neutrally named custom events with no health or condition words, confirm them in Events Manager, build custom conversions on them, and point ad sets at those.
affected: Meta Pixel, health and wellness categories, October 2026
